author: AsphaltMCPE
body: At t7, the two best ways to farm orns are probably orn chests in monuments and memory hunts using diluted mnemonics. You can check which monument has orn chests in the floors you can access using https://floorchart.top/

author: Sensitive_Morning414
body: Ngl just get Summoner and farm raids or complete the achievements for the tower dungeon. They give a lot of orbs. I think every 5 or 10 levels about a couple million.

author: Broad-Student8521
body: Can usually get a good chunk of orns from the Astral tree . Do the dailies for the seeds

author: Warfnair
body: Archivements and arenas are good source of orns. Also whenever you're doing some mighty slaying make sure you pop that silver coin to get some boost. Other than that, orns are not that big of concern on earlier tiers - just keep farming exp and you'll have new things to worry about

author: Snusky
body: I think your best bet right now is to farm overworld bosses, use the silver coin for bonus orns and if you can afford weaker gear use the orn bonus gear(lost helmet has an orns bonus for example), later in the game you will have better orn farming methods, but for now i think bosses are your best bet, also if you can do any achievements they also reward orns

author: 0_Error_0
body: Wait for the plight of apollyon event this month to get maximum buffs for memory hunting.

author: mysterious_sadist
body: The way I did it was grinding out raid bosses
